title.en: English Grammar Golden Rules & Cheat Sheet
title.hi: अंग्रेजी व्याकरण के स्वर्णिम नियम एवं त्वरित सारांश

label.en: Conjunctions that take the First Subject
label.hi: प्रथम कर्ता के अनुसार क्रिया निर्धारित करने वाले संयोजक

cards.plain: Subjects joined by 'as well as', 'along with', 'together with', 'with', 'accompanied by', 'in addition to', 'like', 'unlike', 'except', 'besides' -> Verb agrees with the FIRST Subject.

note.en: Example: 'The captain along with the crew members was saved.' ('was' agrees with singular 'captain').
note.hi: उदा: 'The captain along with the crew was saved.' (क्रिया प्रथम कर्ता 'captain' के अनुसार एकवचन होगी)।

label.en: Conjunctions that take the Nearest Subject
label.hi: निकटतम कर्ता के अनुसार क्रिया निर्धारित करने वाले संयोजक

cards.plain: Subjects joined by 'either... or', 'neither... nor', 'not only... but also', 'or', 'nor' -> Verb agrees with the NEAREST Subject.

note.en: Example: 'Neither the manager nor the employees were present.' ('were' agrees with nearest 'employees').
note.hi: उदा: 'Neither the teacher nor the students were present.' (क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता 'students' के अनुसार बहुवचन होगी)।

label.hi: हमेशा एकवचन में प्रयुक्त होने वाली अगणनीय संज्ञाएँ

cards.plain: Furniture, Advice, Information, Luggage, Baggage, Scenery, Poetry, Machinery, Work, News, Hair, Bread, Stationery, Crockery are uncountable singular nouns (never take 'a/an' or plural 's/es').

note.en: Incorrect: 'The sceneries of Kashmir are beautiful.' Correct: 'The scenery of Kashmir is beautiful.'
note.hi: इनके साथ कभी 's/es' या 'a/an' नहीं लगाते तथा क्रिया हमेशा एकवचन (is/was/has) आती है।

cards.plain: Scarcely / Hardly ... WHEN | No sooner ... THAN | Not only ... BUT ALSO | Barely ... WHEN | Lest ... SHOULD (without 'not') | Although / Though ... YET (or comma) | Between ... AND | From ... TO

note.en: Never use 'then' with 'No sooner' (use 'than'). Never use 'not' with 'lest'. Never use 'and' with 'from' (use 'to').
note.hi: 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' आता है (then नहीं)। 'Lest' के साथ 'should' आता है ('not' नहीं)।

label.hi: इनवर्जन नियम (कर्ता से पूर्व सहायक क्रिया)

cards.plain: When a sentence starts with negative adverbs (Hardly, Scarcely, Seldom, Rarely, Never, Little, No sooner, Under no circumstances) -> Auxiliary Verb + Subject + Main Verb.

note.en: Example: 'Hardly had he arrived when it started raining.' (Not: 'Hardly he had arrived').
note.hi: जब वाक्य नकारात्मक क्रियाविशेषण से शुरू हो, तो 'Hardly had he seen...' (इनवर्जन) रूप प्रयुक्त होता है।

title.hi: कर्तृवाच्य एवं कर्मवाच्य काल परिवर्तन नियम

cards.plain: Simple Present: is/am/are + V3 | Simple Past: was/were + V3 | Continuous: being + V3 | Perfect: been + V3 | Modals (can/may/must): modal + be + V3.

note.en: Note: Perfect Continuous tenses and Future Continuous have NO passive voice forms in standard English examinations.
note.hi: Passive Voice में मुख्य क्रिया हमेशा Past Participle (V3) में होती है तथा Tense के अनुसार 'be' का उचित रूप जुड़ता है।

label.en: Tense and Time Word Shift in Indirect Speech
label.hi: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन में काल एवं समय सूचक शब्दों का परिवर्तन

cards.plain: Present Simple -> Past Simple | Present Continuous -> Past Continuous | Present Perfect -> Past Perfect | Past Simple -> Past Perfect | will/shall -> would/should | can -> could | may -> might | now -> then | today -> that day | tomorrow -> the next day | yesterday -> the previous day | here -> there | this -> that.

note.en: Exception: Universal truths, proverbs, and habitual historical facts DO NOT change tense (e.g. 'The teacher said that the sun rises in the east').
note.hi: अपवाद: सार्वभौमिक सत्य, मुहावरे एवं ऐतिहासिक तथ्यों में Tense नहीं बदलता है।
